#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root="$HOME/.local/share/ji-host"
operation="$root/operations/install-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT-ba0fabdfa990630d"
old=$(cat "$operation/previous-target")
test -n "$old"
test -x "$old/bin/ji-host"
systemctl --user stop ji-host.service
rm -f "$root/current.recover"
ln -s "$old" "$root/current.recover"
mv -Tf "$root/current.recover" "$root/current"
rm -f "$root/run/host-locator"
